nodes.label: --debounce flag
nodes.rationale: Waits until file activity stops before triggering, so a wave of parallel agent writes doesn't trigger a rebuild per file.

nodes.label: FalkorDB export (--falkordb / --falkordb-push)
nodes.rationale: FalkorDB's GRAPH.QUERY runs one statement at a time, unlike Neo4j's bulk cypher-shell import, so --falkordb-push is preferred over generating a Cypher file to load a graph.

nodes.label: Token reduction benchmark
nodes.rationale: Only run when total_words > 5000; for small corpora the graph's value is structural clarity, not token compression.

nodes.label: Monorepo / multi-service layout workflow
nodes.rationale: Running the skill pipeline separately per subfolder would clobber the same graphify-out/ output dir, so the CLI is invoked directly per subfolder, placing graphify-out/ inside each scanned path instead.
